_comment: Fact-check mutation suite: each case is a correct claim from a synthetic source and a corrupted version. The checker must accept `good` and reject `bad`.

cases.good: Scrub your hands for at least 20 seconds.
cases.bad: Scrub your hands for at least 10 seconds.

cases.good: Change gloves at least every 4 hours during continuous use.
cases.bad: Change gloves at least every 8 hours during continuous use.

cases.good: Do not dry your hands on your apron.
cases.bad: Dry your hands on your apron.

cases.good: Never wash your hands in a food preparation sink.
cases.bad: Wash your hands in a food preparation sink.

cases.good: Wet your hands with warm running water.
cases.bad: Wet your hands with hot water mixed with bleach.

cases.good: Dry your hands with a single-use paper towel.
cases.bad: Dry your hands with an electric hand dryer for 30 seconds.

cases.good: Apply soap after wetting your hands.
cases.bad: Apply soap before wetting your hands.

cases.good: Take paracetamol 500 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain.
cases.bad: Take paracetamol 1000 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain.

cases.good: Take ibuprofen 400 mg with food every 8 hours for 5 days.
cases.bad: Take ibuprofen 400 mg with food every 4 hours for 5 days.

cases.good: Do not take more than 4 doses of paracetamol in 24 hours.
cases.bad: Do not take more than 6 doses of paracetamol in 24 hours.

cases.good: Keep the dressing clean and dry for 48 hours.
cases.bad: Keep the dressing clean and dry for 24 hours.

cases.good: Do not drive for 1 week.
cases.bad: You may drive after surgery.

cases.good: Never put ice directly on the skin.
cases.bad: Put ice directly on the skin.

cases.good: Take ibuprofen with food.
cases.bad: Take aspirin with food.

cases.good: Wash your hands before touching the dressing.
cases.bad: Apply antibiotic cream to the wound twice a day.

cases.good: Call your doctor if you have a fever above 38 °C.
cases.bad: Call your doctor if you have a fever above 40 °C.

cases.good: ყინული დაიდეთ მუხლზე 20 წუთით, დღეში 3-ჯერ.
cases.bad: ყინული დაიდეთ მუხლზე 40 წუთით, დღეში 3-ჯერ.

cases.good: 1 კვირის განმავლობაში არ მართოთ მანქანა.
cases.bad: 1 კვირის განმავლობაში შეგიძლიათ მართოთ მანქანა.

cases.good: იხეხეთ ხელები მინიმუმ 20 წამის განმავლობაში.
cases.bad: იხეხეთ ხელები მინიმუმ 5 წამის განმავლობაში.

cases.good: არ გაიმშრალოთ ხელები წინსაფარზე.
cases.bad: გაიმშრალეთ ხელები წინსაფარზე.
